Blind Youth Association Nepal BYAN On 26 January 2024 partial elections to the National Assembly were held to allocate 19 vacant seats. Prior to the filing of candidacy by the political parties BYAN team visited each political partys offices in collaboration with another CSO. Both organisations submitted their statement and demand paper to the political leaders. As a result of their lobbying and advocacy works a total of seven candidates were PwD. Accountability Labs Nepal In January 2024 the government representatives of Nepalgunj SubMetropolitan City Nepal decided to impose a new fine for the public and businesses that dont comply with waste management standards.
